(F) The Wang Fuk Court Project

Application for SDN  
43. Similar to our previous arrangements, PC&E asked China Status to apply for SDNs on its behalf.

44. Given that, as I understood it, PC&E was **itself a RFSIC** and **we had previously worked together on similar arrangements**, I did not consider there to be any issue in doing so.

45. As the works involved fire service water tanks ("**FS Water Tank(s)**"), which China Status does not undertake, I understood that PC&E would carry out, or arrange another company to carry out the repair works under their supervision.  
46. My understanding was that the repair works would require the FS Water Tanks to be emptied and the fire hydrant/hose reel ("**FH/HR**") system suspended. Hence, the purpose of the SDNs was to inform the FSD that the FH/HR systems for all eight buildings in Wang Fuk Court had to be shut down temporarily.

Quotation  
47. I issued and signed a quotation dated 25 March 2025 (the quotation and invoice are at **Bundle R1 RFSIC (1-2)**).
